decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted for the theatre and sixth form centre building purpose shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for a theatre purpose shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the entrance canopy roof against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 7 - The development shall not be used as a theatre until the Local Planning Authority approves full details of how the existing vehicular access to Clifden Road will be managed during the use of the theatre.
description: Erection of a 2 storey building for use as a new theatre (min 160 seat capacity) with sixth form centre above.
